_comment: Quest log, kept by the server (realm_rules quests.rs). Generated by tools/quests/gen_quests.py - edit the table there and re-run. Two quests per level 1-50. A quest is open once the player reached its `level` and claimed every quest in `requires`; open quests accumulate and progress independently. A finished quest waits in `ready` until the player claims it, which pays the reward. Types: talk (target = NPC name, within talk_radius), kill (target = mob species from its scene; `boss` counts only boss kills), dummy (hits on a training dummy), equip (target = equipment slot), refine (a successful refinement), enchant (a successful imbue), monolith, dungeon (target = dungeons.json id, the run completes), enter_map (target = map id), visit (target = a place below; `mounted` requires the skiff). Rewards: reward_exp (a share of the level's experience threshold by size; a level's quests with the kills they ask for pay at least its threshold, so the chain never waits for a level: tools/quests/quest_flow.py), reward_gold, reward_house_rep, reward_items [{id, amount}] (bag, or a personal chest at the player's feet when it is full). Progress persists in the character's `quests` object (progress, ready, done).

chapters.title: The First Watch
chapters.desc: Take your oath at Kaf Castle, the Vigil's fortress over the shard of the fallen World-Star Ithrel: your cloak, your first spells, your patrol skiff.

chapters.title: The Forest Edge
chapters.desc: Darkened shards fall into the Raven Woods and the creatures grow bolder; learn the forge and the trial.

chapters.title: Roads to Orvell
chapters.desc: Bandits prowl the roads; the village needs a rod it can trust.

chapters.title: Crypts and Trolls
chapters.desc: The dead stir in the crypts, the trolls come down from their hollow - and an old name turns up in the records: the Ash Priest.

chapters.title: Barrows and Webs
chapters.desc: The dead rise in the barrows; deep in the caverns the Silk Queen broods on a shard the Ash Priest gave her.

chapters.title: The Moors
chapters.desc: Trolls and the Ash Priest's Ashbound hold the moors above Orvell.

chapters.title: The Brine Vaults
chapters.desc: Under the east wing the first Vigil drowned its own mistake: vaults of brine, a garrison walled in, and a great engine still turning.

chapters.title: Stone and Storm
chapters.desc: Mountain trolls gather under Grak around a Dark Shard on the Stone Circle Summit.

chapters.title: The Long Mist
chapters.desc: The mist of Morhal rolls in from the shore and the Mistguards with it; only Dawnbreak will hold them back.

chain.title: Sworn In
chain.name: Speak with Commander Teral Venn by the fountain
chain.desc: Commander Teral Venn waits beside the courtyard fountain (the bobbing gold arrow). Walk up and click him or press {key:interact} to talk.

chain.title: Dressed for the Grounds
chain.name: Wear the Woolen Traveller's Cloak
chain.desc: Open your bag with {key:inventory} and right-click the cloak Commander Teral Venn gave you. It costs a little speed and buys a lot of armour.

chain.title: Rod Drills
chain.name: Hit a training dummy 5 times
chain.desc: Three training dummies stand in the fenced training yard east of the castle doors, beside the skiff landing pad - they never hit back. Left-click to cast; spells hurt nothing on protected ground.

chain.title: Spiders at the Gate
chain.name: Defeat 6 Black Weavers
chain.desc: Leave the courtyard for the Village Outskirts or the Field Outskirts. Hit one spider and its pack answers - keep moving.

chain.title: Restless Dead
chain.name: Defeat 6 Saltwights
chain.desc: Saltwights stalk the Forest Edge past Ombrek's lookout. Fire (Flame Wave) hurts them twice as much.

chain.title: Ombrek's Lookout
chain.name: Report to Ombrek at his lookout
chain.desc: Ombrek, the Vigil's pathwarden, keeps watch from his lookout west of the castle.

chain.title: Thinning the Brood
chain.name: Defeat 10 Black Weavers
chain.desc: The spiders breed faster than anyone can count. Greenhouse Meadow is crawling with them.

chain.title: Through the Great Doors
chain.name: Enter Kaf Castle
chain.desc: Walk up the castle approach and press {key:interact} in the doorway to go inside.

chain.title: Your First Skiff
chain.name: Collect your skiff from Sergeant Kaelen Rook
chain.desc: At level 5 every recruit is issued a patrol skiff. Sergeant Kaelen Rook waits at the castle approach.

chain.title: First Patrol
chain.name: Fly your skiff to the Patrol Field
chain.desc: Equip the skiff, press {key:ride} to mount, {key:jump} to rise and {key:descend} to descend. Land on level ground and press {key:ride} to dismount.

chain.title: Ash and Bone
chain.name: Defeat 12 Saltwights
chain.desc: The Saltwights gather again at the Forest Edge and in Greenhouse Meadow.

chain.title: Kestrin's Forge
chain.name: Fly to Orvell and speak with Kestrin
chain.desc: Kestrin keeps his forge on the west side of Orvell square, east of the castle along the road. Mount your skiff and fly there - he can make a rod stronger, at a price.

chain.title: A Stronger Rod
chain.name: Refine your rod once at Kestrin
chain.desc: Press {key:workshop} to open Kestrin's workshop, drag your rod onto the anvil and refine it with Forge Cinder and Oril.

chain.title: The Eastern Road
chain.name: Defeat 12 Black Weavers
chain.desc: Merchants on the Eastern Road are turning back. Clear the spiders from the verges.

chain.title: Woven Magic
chain.name: Enchant an item at Kestrin
chain.desc: Put any piece of gear on the anvil and use an Imbue Scroll. A failed weave still spends the scroll.

chain.title: The Long Road Home
chain.name: Defeat 14 Saltwights
chain.desc: Saltwights wander onto the Eastern Road at dusk. Keep the road open.

chain.title: Weaver Thicket
chain.name: Defeat 16 Black Weavers
chain.desc: West of the forest edge the spiders grow to the size of carts. Bring potions.

chain.title: Shatter the Darkness
chain.name: Help destroy a Dark Shard
chain.desc: The Ash Priest drags darkened star shards out of the Void and they fall in the western forests: at the Forest Edge past Ombrek's lookout, in the Weaver Thicket beyond it, in Bandit Woods to the north-west and in Crypt Hollow far to the west. Close by, a green light rises over the trees. Break one with others before its waves overrun you.

chain.title: The Trial Hall
chain.name: Complete the Trial Hall
chain.desc: The Trial Hall stands on the castle's east terrace, south of the road. Press {key:interact} at its glowing door, clear the corridor, then defeat the Trial Warden. Up to five can go in together.

chain.title: A Rod Worth Keeping
chain.name: Equip the Runebound Walnut Rod
chain.desc: Your new rod rolls a far higher Attack and Magic Attack Value. Equip it from your bag.

chain.title: Bandits on the Road
chain.name: Defeat 10 Bandits
chain.desc: Bandits waylay travellers on the Orvell Road. They cast back - keep your distance.

chain.title: The Red Lantern
chain.name: Speak with Bessa Tull in Orvell
chain.desc: Bessa Tull keeps the Red Lantern on the north side of Orvell square, a few steps from Kestrin's forge. She knows every rumour in the valley.

chain.title: Field Woods
chain.name: Defeat 15 Black Weavers
chain.desc: The woods behind the Patrol Field are thick with webs.

chain.title: Lakeside Glade
chain.name: Defeat 15 Saltwights
chain.desc: Saltwights crawl out of Lake Lunra at the Lakeside Glade.

chain.title: Bandit Woods
chain.name: Defeat 14 Bandits
chain.desc: The bandits have a camp in the woods north-west of the castle. Drive them out.

chain.title: Survey the Lake
chain.name: Visit the Lakeside Glade
chain.desc: Ombrek wants to know how far the Saltwights have spread along the shore.

chain.title: Webs in the Glade
chain.name: Defeat 18 Black Weavers
chain.desc: Spiders and dead share the Lakeside Glade now. Clear the spiders first.

chain.title: Steel for the Road
chain.name: Refine any item twice
chain.desc: Kestrin can refine cloaks, accessories and skiffs as well as rods.

chain.title: Breaking the Ring
chain.name: Defeat 18 Bandits
chain.desc: Bessa has heard the bandits answer to a captain. Weaken them before he moves.

chain.title: Crypt Hollow
chain.name: Defeat 18 Saltwights
chain.desc: Deeper in the forest the old crypt has split open. The Saltwights climb out of its ruin and pour across Crypt Hollow.

chain.title: Records of the Crypt
chain.name: Speak with Archivist Emrel Sav
chain.desc: Archivist Emrel Sav keeps the records of every grave in the valley - and one old entry names the Ash Priest, who once tried to open the gate of Morhal. She waits at the castle approach.

chain.title: Troll Hollow
chain.name: Defeat 6 Forest Trolls
chain.desc: Forest trolls hit hard and slowly. Watch for the slam and step out of it.

chain.title: Sealing the Crypt
chain.name: Defeat 20 Saltwights
chain.desc: Keep the Saltwights in Crypt Hollow from reaching the forest paths.

chain.title: Dark Thicket
chain.name: Defeat 16 Bandits
chain.desc: The bandits fell back into the Dark Thicket, far to the west.

chain.title: Hollow Drums
chain.name: Defeat 10 Forest Trolls
chain.desc: The trolls beat drums every night. Silence them.

chain.title: Spider Woods
chain.name: Defeat 20 Black Weavers
chain.desc: Larger spiders hunt in the Spider Woods; something is feeding them.

chain.title: The Southern Barrows
chain.name: Defeat 22 Saltwights
chain.desc: The barrows south of the lake have broken open.

chain.title: The Smugglers' Camp
chain.name: Scout the Smugglers' Camp
chain.desc: Find the bandit captain's camp deep in the northern woods, past Bandit Woods. Do not engage alone.

chain.title: The Bandit Chief
chain.name: Defeat the captain at the Smugglers' Camp
chain.desc: Gather friends and defeat the Bandit Chief in his camp.

chain.title: Last of the Hollow
chain.name: Defeat 10 Forest Trolls
chain.desc: Without the bandits' coin the trolls of the hollow will scatter. Finish them.

chain.title: Ridge Path
chain.name: Defeat 20 Bandits
chain.desc: The captain's men fled up the Ridge Path. Hunt them down.

chain.title: Barrow Watch
chain.name: Defeat 24 Saltwights
chain.desc: Hold the Southern Barrows while Archivist Emrel Sav searches her records.

chain.title: Brood of the Woods
chain.name: Defeat 22 Black Weavers
chain.desc: Every spider in the Spider Woods answers to one mother.

chain.title: Crypt Gate
chain.name: Defeat 24 Saltwights
chain.desc: The Crypt Gate to the west is the source. Thin the dead around it.

chain.title: Weaving for War
chain.name: Enchant items twice
chain.desc: Kestrin says no one should face the Hollow Spinner with bare robes.

chain.title: Ridge Ambush
chain.name: Defeat 22 Bandits
chain.desc: The bandits ambush anyone who climbs the Ridge Path.

chain.title: The Hollow Spinner's Guard
chain.name: Defeat 26 Black Weavers
chain.desc: Clear the spiders that guard the way to Spider Hollow.

chain.title: Spider Hollow
chain.name: Find Spider Hollow
chain.desc: The Hollow Spinner nests in Spider Hollow in the far south-west, beyond the Spider Woods. In the slope west of the hollow a cave mouth leads down to the Blackweb Caverns.

chain.title: The Hollow Spinner
chain.name: Defeat the Hollow Spinner
chain.desc: Bring a party. The Hollow Spinner's bite poisons and her brood answers her call.

chain.title: Gate of Bones
chain.name: Defeat 26 Saltwights
chain.desc: With the Hollow Spinner gone, Archivist Emrel Sav can finally seal the Crypt Gate.

chain.title: The Forge's Fire
chain.name: Refine any item three times
chain.desc: The moors are harder still. Kestrin will not let you go up there half-made.

chain.title: Western Moor
chain.name: Defeat 12 Forest Trolls
chain.desc: Forest trolls have climbed onto the Western Moor.

chain.title: Moorland Orders
chain.name: Speak with Sergeant Kaelen Rook
chain.desc: Kaelen Rook is organising the patrols that go up to the moors.

chain.title: Trolls on the Heath
chain.name: Defeat 12 Forest Trolls
chain.desc: Push the forest trolls off the Western Moor.

chain.title: Orvell Heights
chain.name: Defeat 22 Bandits
chain.desc: The heights above Orvell are crawling with the Ashbound.

chain.title: Watchers on the Heights
chain.name: Defeat 24 Bandits
chain.desc: They are watching the village. Make them stop.

chain.title: Clearing the Heights
chain.name: Defeat 26 Bandits
chain.desc: One last push and Orvell can sleep again.

chain.title: The Highland Moor
chain.name: Reach the Highland Moor
chain.desc: Mountain trolls have been seen on the Highland Moor, north of the Patrol Field.

chain.title: Mountain Trolls
chain.name: Defeat 8 Mountain Trolls
chain.desc: Mountain trolls throw boulders as well as fists. Keep moving.

chain.title: Boulder Throwers
chain.name: Defeat 10 Mountain Trolls
chain.desc: Every troll you fell is one less marching on the castle.

chain.title: Below the Waterline
chain.name: Speak with Archivist Emrel Sav about the vaults
chain.desc: Archivist Emrel Sav has found the old order: the vaults under the east wing were flooded and walled up with their garrison inside. The wall has cracked.

chain.title: Drafts in the Vaults
chain.name: Defeat 8 Galelings
chain.desc: Enter the Brine Vaults from the castle. Galelings ride the cold drafts and throw you off your feet.

chain.title: Empty Posts
chain.name: Defeat 6 Hollow Sentries
chain.desc: Armour with no one inside still walks its rounds. Force spells shake it apart.

chain.title: The Hollow Castellan
chain.name: Defeat the Hollow Castellan
chain.desc: The last castellan of the vaults still holds the deep cellar.

chain.title: Brinebriar
chain.name: Cut down the Brinebriar
chain.desc: Flame only steams it. Frost and force crack the stems; then strike the heart.

chain.title: More Galelings
chain.name: Defeat 10 Galelings
chain.desc: The galelings on the stair below are worse than the first lot.

chain.title: Wheelwarden
chain.name: Defeat the Wheelwarden
chain.desc: Turn the sluice wheel to flood its joints, then break its plates while it is seized.

chain.title: The Vaults Drained
chain.name: Complete the Brine Vaults
chain.desc: Run the vaults from the first drafts to the flood gate in one go.

chain.title: A Rod for the Storm
chain.name: Speak with Kestrin
chain.desc: Kestrin has finished a rod worthy of what comes next.

chain.title: Eastern Moor
chain.name: Defeat 12 Mountain Trolls
chain.desc: Grak's trolls hold the Eastern Moor.

chain.title: Grak's Allies
chain.name: Defeat 26 Bandits
chain.desc: The Ashbound march with the trolls on the Eastern Moor.

chain.title: The Troll Muster
chain.name: Defeat 14 Mountain Trolls
chain.desc: Break the muster before it reaches the summit.

chain.title: Storm Riders
chain.name: Defeat 28 Bandits
chain.desc: The Ashbound ride the storm clouds over the moor.

chain.title: Ember Weave
chain.name: Enchant items three times
chain.desc: Velkar Regalia deserves its weave. Make the most of it.

chain.title: Stone Circle Summit
chain.name: Climb to the Stone Circle Summit
chain.desc: Grak, the Mountain Troll Chieftain, waits at the summit, where his clans worship a fallen Dark Shard.

chain.title: Grak the Chieftain
chain.name: Defeat Grak, Mountain Troll Chieftain
chain.desc: Grak only appears every so often. Gather a party and be ready.

chain.title: Scattering the Clans
chain.name: Defeat 16 Mountain Trolls
chain.desc: Without their chieftain the clans fight among themselves. Finish them.

chain.title: Deserters
chain.name: Defeat 28 Bandits
chain.desc: The Ashbound who marched with Grak are fleeing across the Eastern Moor.

chain.title: Stones Still Standing
chain.name: Destroy a Dark Shard or a Webbound Seal Stone
chain.desc: Grak is gone, but the Ash Priest keeps pulling shards down. Break a Dark Shard in the western forests or a Webbound Seal Stone in the Blackweb Caverns, with others.

chain.title: Masterwork
chain.name: Refine any item three times
chain.desc: Mistguards are coming. Kestrin wants every piece you own at its best.

chain.title: Dawnbreak
chain.name: Speak with Commander Teral Venn about Dawnbreak
chain.desc: Commander Teral Venn says the Mistguards give ground to nothing but Dawnbreak, a fan of hard light drawn from the World-Star. Learn it in your spell book (V) - it opens at level 40.

chain.title: The Misty Shore
chain.name: Defeat 10 Mistguards
chain.desc: Mistguards march in from the Misty Shore. Their aura stops your health from recovering.

chain.title: Landing Mist
chain.name: Defeat 12 Mistguards
chain.desc: The old landing is lost in the mist.

chain.title: Cold Quay
chain.name: Defeat 12 more Mistguards
chain.desc: Hold the quay until the mist lifts.

chain.title: Shoreline Vigil
chain.name: Defeat 14 Mistguards
chain.desc: Keep the Misty Shore clear for the boats.

chain.title: Warmth Against the Cold
chain.name: Enchant items three times
chain.desc: Kestrin has a theory about weaves that hold off the numbing cold.

chain.title: Fog Barrens
chain.name: Defeat 14 Mistguards
chain.desc: South of the castle the Fog Barrens have swallowed the road.

chain.title: Into the Fog
chain.name: Reach the Fog Barrens
chain.desc: Mark the edge of the fog so the others can follow.

chain.title: Shades of the Barrens
chain.name: Defeat 16 Mistguards
chain.desc: The deeper you go, the colder it gets.

chain.title: Lights in the Fog
chain.name: Defeat 16 more Mistguards
chain.desc: Every Dawnbreak you cast lights the way for someone else.

chain.title: Grey Marsh
chain.name: Defeat 16 Mistguards
chain.desc: The Grey Marsh is where the mist begins.

chain.title: The Last Polish
chain.name: Refine any item three times
chain.desc: Kestrin wants one more look at your gear before the end.

chain.title: Marsh Sentries
chain.name: Defeat 18 Mistguards
chain.desc: Mistguards circle a barrow at the far end of the marsh.

chain.title: Breaking the Circle
chain.name: Defeat 18 more Mistguards
chain.desc: Break their circle and the barrow is exposed.

chain.title: The Cold Heart
chain.name: Defeat 20 Mistguards
chain.desc: Something at the heart of the marsh calls them.

chain.title: Marshal's Barrow
chain.name: Find the Marshal's Barrow
chain.desc: The Morhal Marshal keeps his last post in a barrow in the marsh.

chain.title: Before the Storm
chain.name: Defeat 22 Mistguards
chain.desc: Clear the way to the barrow for your party.

chain.title: Final Preparations
chain.name: Speak with Commander Teral Venn
chain.desc: Commander Teral Venn has one last piece of advice before you face the Morhal Marshal, the first commander of the Vigil the mist ever took.

chain.title: The Morhal Marshal
chain.name: Defeat the Morhal Marshal
chain.desc: Gather your strongest friends. The Marshal's cold stops the blood.

chain.title: The Watch Relieved
chain.name: Report your victory to Commander Teral Venn
chain.desc: The valley is safe - for now. The Ash Priest has fled through a rift into another realm. Commander Teral Venn is waiting to congratulate you.
